blurb: Browns Mill Golf Course offers 18 holes of golf with rental sets available for $40 for 18 holes and $20 for 9 holes. The course operates with different green fees depending on the day and residency status. Power cart and pull cart fees apply separately.
extraNote: All tee times are reserved on a pay-at-course basis. · There is a rack rate per player no-show fee for any missed reservations within 24 hours of the scheduled tee time. · Tee times cancelled more than 24 hours in advance from the reservation time will not be subject to the no-show fee.
cancellation: Tee times cancelled more than 24 hours in advance from the reservation time will not be subject to the no-show fee.
